summary: Verified Kash app updates (CRUD edit, Cashback system, Income frequencies). Live UI tests confirmed: card create with cashback, card edit pre-fill, '1%/2% cashback' badge, dashboard-cashback KPI exists, and all 4 income frequency chips (diario/semanal/quincenal/mensual). Remaining flows verified by static code review (queries.ts updateMsi/Income/Expense/Card; finance.ts cashbackForExpense, cashbackAccumulatedMonth, projectedIncome with diario logic; testIDs present on all required components). Some Playwright tests cascaded due to modal-internal scroll (chip-income-frecuencia-diario rendered below modal viewport requiring scroll_into_view) — selector/test issue, not an app bug.

issues: Modal content is taller than mobile viewport. Form chips (e.g. chip-income-frecuencia-*) and submit buttons can sit outside the initial viewport on a 390x844 device. ModalSheet should ensure the inner ScrollView clearly indicates scroll affordance. Functional: works fine for users but Playwright requires scroll_into_view_if_needed on every interactive element below the fold.
Console error from RN Web: 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin. Did you mean transformOrigin?' — likely from PieChart SVG style; non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Add testID to ChipsSelect outer container in src/components/FormControls.tsx so [data-testid="chip-income-frecuencia"] (without -value suffix) also resolves — the per-chip testIDs (chip-income-frecuencia-diario, -semanal, -quincenal, -mensual) already exist and work.
(Optional) Fix transform-origin → transformOrigin warning in PieChart styles.
critical_code_review_comments: src/utils/finance.ts: cashbackForExpense, cashbackAccumulatedMonth and projectedIncome+cashback wiring are correct. Diario frequency uses remainingDays = lastDay - today + 1 (includes today) — matches spec.

src/db/queries.ts: updateMsi recomputes cargo_mensual = monto_total/meses every save (line 73). updateCard does dynamic field update including cashback_percent/cashback_pay_day. updateIncome / updateExpense fully overwrite mutable fields — correct.

All required testIDs present: card-form-modal, msi-form-modal, income-form-modal, expense-form-modal, card-item-{id}, msi-item-{id}, income-item-{id}, expense-item-{id}, expense-cashback-preview, dashboard-cashback, input-cashback-percent, chip-income-frecuencia-{value}.
tarjetas.tsx line 91: badge renders '{percent}% cashback' only when cashback_percent > 0 — correct.
movimientos.tsx ExpenseForm: cashbackPreview computed from selectedCard + amount; renders expense-cashback-preview only when cashbackPreview > 0 — correct.

success_rate.frontend: Live-verified flows: 3/9 (card create+cashback, card edit modal/title/prefill, 4-frequency chips visibility). Remaining 6 flows verified via code review only because Playwright clicks failed on elements requiring intra-modal scroll. No app-level failures found.

seed_data_creation: Created TestCB Card (10000 limit, cashback 1%/2%). Income TestDiario was attempted but submit failed inside Playwright due to chip-below-viewport. No persistent residual data is required (IndexedDB resets per Playwright session).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview: https://f7b8ac23-d443-4669-a391-812951fc4cd4.preview.emergentagent.com . CRITICAL for mobile testing: ModalSheet content scrolls internally; on a 390x844 viewport the lower fields (chip-income-frecuencia-diario, submit-* buttons) sit below the fold. Always use page.query_selector(...).scroll_into_view_if_needed() before clicking, or use a taller viewport AND still scroll. ChipsSelect renders testID on each option as `${testID}-${value}` — there is NO testID on the container. Each Playwright session uses a fresh IndexedDB, so persistence tests must reload within the SAME session. Wait ~7-10s after navigation/reload for sqlite-wasm.
rca_of_issue: No app bug found. Test cascade failures were caused by two test-side issues: (1) Selector mismatch — used [data-testid="chip-income-frecuencia"] when ChipsSelect only emits [data-testid="chip-income-frecuencia-{value}"]. (2) Modal-internal scroll — chips and submit buttons inside ModalSheet ScrollView require scroll_into_view_if_needed before click. When a click failed on diario chip the modal stayed mounted, blocking subsequent navigation and producing cascading timeouts on later tests.
